messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - az3.ap-southeast-1 - 90%+ request errors to inference-runner pool. Service: inference-service-prod. Alert ID: PD-INC-8821. Auto-page: primary oncall.
Olivia Jacobs: acked and taking this. gimme a sec to pull logs and confirm blast radius.
PagerDuty: <https://pagerduty.example/PD-INC-8821|PD-INC-8821> acknowledged by Olivia Jacobs at 2026-03-14T02:01:12Z. Escalation timer paused.
Samir Patel: seeing repeated `connect reset by peer` from az3 egress nodes to external model shard host groups. Inter-AZ fabric errors and high retransmits. Logs snippet:```ERROR inference-runner/kvcache.go:232: failed to fetch shard prefix: rpc timeout -> write reset -> conn close```
Marta Chen: metric view: 5xx rate for az3 up from 0.4% -> 47% in last 6m. p95 latency spiking 3x. Traffic volume normal. Looks like network-level failures not model CPU.
Nikhil Rao: verified host-level: top-of-rack shows flaps on leaf-12, peer port 49 toggling. BGP neighbor resets observed. This matches the fabric hypothesis.
Olivia Jacobs: impact assessment: all routes served from az3 for customers in ap-southeast-1 hitting inference-service-prod are experiencing errors or long tails. Some traffic already falling back per routing policy but not enough due to sticky session affinity for long-running streams. Need immediate mitigation: open fallback routing to az2 and disable streaming affinity for affected routes.
Samir Patel: suggested mitigation steps:
1) shift routing weight away from az3 to az2 with immediate 100% failover for route tag `region:apse1`
2) disable streaming-affinity (kvCache sticky sessions) for that tag to allow new streams on az2
3) scale up az2 dedicated pool + apply burst capacity for 10m
Runbook commands (tested dry-run locally):
```bash
# add override route to traffic-router
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  https://router.internal/api/v1/overrides \
  -d '{"selector":"region:apse1","action":{"type":"route_override","target":"az2.ap-southeast-1","weight":1.0}}'
# disable affinity
curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/flags -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -d '{"feature":"streaming_affinity","env":"prod","selector":"region:apse1","value":false}'
# scale az2 pool
gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize inference-pool-az2 --size=40 --project=redwood-prod
```
Olivia Jacobs: executing step 1 -> applying router override now. I'll post when complete.
ops-bot: router.override applied id=ovr-2026-AP-001 by Olivia Jacobs. TTL=15m.
Nikhil Rao: initiating scaling tickets and enabling burst capacity, ETA ~ 2m.
Support Triage: starting customer comms: staging status page update draft - "Investigating increased error rates for inference in ap-southeast-1. Failover to healthy AZs in progress. Some streaming sessions may disconnect; short retries recommended."
Marta Chen: after override, error rate for az3 drops by routing weight but internal attempts still hit az3 because of existing sticky sessions. We see partial recovery: overall 5xx down to ~12% but streaming failures continuing.
Olivia Jacobs: step 2 in progress - disabling affinity for region:apse1. Applying config change.
ops-bot: config flag update accepted id=cfg-4512 by Olivia Jacobs.
Samir Patel: suggestion: enable prefix-level KV cache warmup in az2 to reduce cold-start errors for re-routed streams. Triggering cache-warmup job now:```make warmup REGION=ap-southeast-1 TARGET=az2```
Samir Patel: warmup job logs indicate warmup passing for most shards, ~75% warmed in first 90s.
PagerDuty: PD-INC-8821 escalated to Level 2 at 2026-03-14T02:05:22Z (no response from Level 2 in window).
Olivia Jacobs: handoff note to Level 2: fabric flaps on leaf-12 causing inter-AZ connectivity loss. Immediate mitigations applied: routing override -> az2, disabled streaming affinity, scaled az2 pool, cache warmup. Observed overall error rate drop to 3.8% in last 3m. Need oncall infra to validate fabric and coordinate with DC networking.
Nikhil Rao: opening DC networking PD: created ticket NET-AP-331 referencing leaf-12, attaching BGP and port flap logs.
Marta Chen: verifying customer impact by org: small percentage of customers (approx 4%) had active streaming sessions that saw disconnects; most short-lived and recovered on retry. We'll prepare a post-incident summary with affected customer IDs and duration.
Support Triage: posted status update: "Mitigation in progress: traffic successfully routed to healthy AZs. Some streaming sessions in ap-southeast-1 may have experienced disconnects; we are continuing to monitor."
Olivia Jacobs: pinging infra owners for manual confirmation and patch: @Nikhil Rao @samir please pull port counters and check for hardware errors. Also schedule a maintenance window for leaf-12 replacement if needed.
Nikhil Rao: port counters show excessive CRC errors on spine6->leaf-12 link. Raising hardware replacement request to on-site techs.
Samir Patel: monitoring p95 latency: back to baseline for non-streaming requests; streaming reconnect rates dropping. Recommend keep overrides for 30m then gradually shift weight back after network green.
Olivia Jacobs: marking incident as "mitigated" for customer-facing status at 02:12Z but keeping PD page open until network confirmed. Handoff to Level 2: please own follow-up and RCA. I'll create action items.
PagerDuty: PD-INC-8821 status: Mitigated (acknowledged) at 2026-03-14T02:12:05Z by Olivia Jacobs.
Olivia Jacobs: follow-up tasks created: [RCA - fabric flap], [hardware replacement leaf-12], [postmortem customer impact draft], [tune session-affinity timeouts]. Assigning to Level 2.
Nikhil Rao: assigned NET-AP-331 to on-site techs, ETA hardware swap 4h.
Marta Chen: adding metric alert tweak so sticky session fallback triggers earlier next time (lower threshold).
Olivia Jacobs: thanks all — handover to Level 2. Level 2 owners please acknowledge in-thread when you pick this up.
Samir Patel: acking for Level 2 infra side, will drive RCA and coordinate with networking.
Support Triage: keeping customers informed. Closing thread for primary oncall.
